title: Staffed
pitch: Staff any project with coordinated subagent roles. Use with Pi, OpenAI Codex, or Claude Code.
description: Eleven Markdown personas, from PM and UX to builder and reviewer, plus a skill that tells your agent when to dispatch them. Each role writes its result to a file, so the next one picks up from there.

externals.name: Agent host (Pi, OpenAI Codex or Claude Code)
externals.seam: Host detection looks for ~/.claude, ~/.codex or ~/.pi/agent; the demo home has an empty ~/.claude
externals.note: The roles and skill are really installed, into an empty Claude Code folder, but no agent runs them here.
